newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse estimated flat at 14,915 pts.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse estimated flat at 14,915 pts.

text.p: 0940 GMT - Polish shares were flat after a three-session fall and buying was stronger at order balancing after price fixing, early unofficial results showed.
Reuter calculations based on the preliminary figures showed the main market's all-share WIG index virtually flat at 14,915 points as losers led gainers by 39 to 30 with 13 stocks stable.
On the parallel market 12 stocks fell, 10 rose and one was flat. Mass privatisation NFI units were flat at 119.5 zlotys. The NIF index was estimated up 1.7 percent to 124 points.
Trade in BIG was suspended on Tuesday. Four other firms remained suspended due to flooding.
* At 1002 GMT buying was stronger at the main market's order balancing session still under way with 71 stocks showing greater demand and nine greater supply.
* The biggest losers were: Budimex (10 pct), WBK (4.4 pct), Drosed (4.4 pct), Prochem (4.3 pct), Rolimpex (3.4 pct), Polisa (3.3 pct) and Universal (3.1 pct).
* The top gainers were: Prochnik (9.9 pct), PPABank (5.3 pct), Zasada (5.1 pct), Kety (4.8 pct) and Optimus (4.7 pct).
* Polifarb Wroclaw, Rafako, ZEW and Viscoplast remained suspended due to flooding.
